hypothesis: The existing quiet-check ordering bonus can recognize useful discovered checks and special checking moves that direct destination-square masks miss. Earlier ordering may save search when these quiet moves force a reply.
change: Use Position::gives_check(m) for the existing +16384 quiet-check bonus while retaining the original static exchange safety threshold of -75.
alternative_explanation: The added check calculation over many ordinary quiet moves may cost more than the extra ordering signal saves.
history: 7988de4a added discovered/double-check ordering to captures, and 63a2ab15 simplified capture scoring later. This experiment concerns quiet-move ordering only. It changes neither legal move generation, pruning, search extensions, network evaluation nor UCI options.

bench.primary_observation: Record deterministic node signatures, CPU and elapsed times, and NPS. An apparent slowdown needs more observations and hardware before interpretation.

mechanism_probe.interpretation: A quiet knight move uncovers rook check along the e-file. The destination square provides no direct knight check on e8. This is a diagnostic of predicate coverage, independent of strength.

checks: all upstream standard and Chess960 perft positions
upstream reproducible search at 20 node budgets
match: Testing agent owns the preregistered tactical-position and broad-opening paired screens. Separate suite-specific diagnostics from claims about overall playing strength. Candidate remains unpromoted and unsubmitted to Fishtest.
